item.title: Mini crackme: LEA multiply check
item.description:
Windows x64: check(int x), x in ECX, returns 1 in AL if accepted.
check: lea eax, [rcx+rcx*2] shl eax, 2 sub eax, 5 cmp eax, 0x1F3 sete al ret
What x makes check return 1?
Answer: x = 42. 1. lea is plain arithmetic here: eax = 3x; shl 2 gives 12x; sub 5 gives 12x-5. 2. 0x1F3 = 499, so 12x - 5 = 499. 3. 12x = 504, so x = 42 (unique).
